why: Item 1 is met: builder step 7 runs npm install and commits package-lock.json, giving npm ci as the reason. Item 2 is met: step 6 says "replace the 'No tools yet' bullet". Item 4 is met: verifier Check 6 reads the PR body and headRefOid with gh, then checks the test workflow at the head commit. Item 3 is not met. Check 4 counts tests only for `npm test -w jsonl-lint`, which calls the workspace directly. Check 6 runs root `npm ci && npm test` and only asks that it "exits 0". Because the root script uses --if-present, that can pass while the jsonl-lint tests are skipped. The verifier never reads the test count from the root run and never breaks lint() to see a test fail, so it would miss the tests being skipped under the root npm test.
